obligations.source_text: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

bindings.front_placket_phrase: a complete center-front button placket remains visible from the collar stand to the tucked waist
bindings.point_collar_phrase: two pointed collar tips remain separately readable and symmetrically frame the uncovered neck
bindings.collar_buttons_phrase: one small button fastens each collar point, with two distinct collar-point buttons plainly visible
bindings.collar_attachment_phrase: both collar tips visibly attach to the shirt body as the point buttons pass through collar-tip buttonholes
bindings.button_up_confound_phrase: a generic button-up placket does not substitute for collar fastening; the paired point-button attachments carry the distinction
